Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan bowled really well and it was Rahat Ali who bowled his heart out on a deck which has nothing for the pacers. He grabbed three while Sohail Khan got two to his name. Yasir Shah spun the web and got rewards yet again, it's very rare if he doesn't get a wicket. Got a 4-fer and did trouble the Windies in this innings. Misbah has taken the call to give rest to his bowlers which means the home side will come out to bat again. How many sessions will they bat? It remains to be seen but as of now the hosts have a firm grip on this Test. Join us back shortly for the final session!

AN EARLY TEA HAS BEEN TAKEN! A dismal batting performance from the Windies has seen them staring down the barrel in this Test. Though their batsmen tried to grind in the middle but that wasn't meant to be. The lower-order couldn't show any resistance as they have given a huge lead of 228 runs to the home side.

Welcome back for the second session of play. SHAI HOPE and ROSTON CHASE are out to bat for West Indies. Hope will take the strike. YASIR SHAH to bowl first up after lunch.
...DAY 3...SESSION 2....

Rahat Ali began the session well for them. Both the spinners kept the runs down but did not trouble the visitors that much. Pakistan will want to wrap things up early after the first break. How both teams go in the next session could decide how this Test pans out. Do join us in a bit for the second session.

Game time! The two West Indies batsmen are out to bat, DEVENDRA BISHOO and JERMAINE BLACKWOOD. Pakistan will want to strike early and they begin the day with RAHAT ALI!

With the bat though, the struggle continued for West Indies. They were in a relatively good position going into stumps before some poor cricket saw them losing two quick wickets and are now in a dicey position. They will want to put up a good fight as the trail is still 346 runs. Will Pakistan manage to bowl them out and enforce the follow-on or will we see a resistance from the Windies? Stay tuned to find out.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of day three of the second Test between Pakistan and West Indies. The hosts are sitting pretty on top, thanks to vital contributions from the veterans in Younis Khan and Misbah-ul-Haq who scored 127 and 96 respectively. Gabriel was the star performer for the Windies with his maiden 5-fer and he helped keeping Pakistan to 452.
...DAY 3...SESSION 1....

Samuels then along with Brathwaite started to counter-attack but a lapse in concentration got the better of the former. Last over of the day saw Brathwaite getting run out and that tilted the momentum and changed the complexion of the game. Pakistan are on top at the moment as the tourists still trail by 346 runs and have half a dozen wickets remaining. Will Yasir Shah and co. bowl them out in a jiffy? Or will we see some resistance from the Windies lower-middle order? The make or bake day awaits us, so do join us tomorrow at 1130 IST for all the action. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheerio!

Off goes the bails and off trudge the players to their respective dressing rooms! End of a fabulous day of Test cricket! West Indies showed a good fight today but slipped towards the end as they lost two wickets in quick succession. After bowling out the home side for 452, they came out with a cautious mindset. Bravo and Johnson played sensibly but that was only for a while. Bravo was looking set for another big innings but Yasir Shah got rid of the big fish by rapping him on the pads.
Floats it on middle, Blackwood keeps it out. That will be it STUMPS, DAY 2!
Shorter outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Floated on middle and leg, Blackwood comes forward and edges it towards mid-wicket.
Blackwood comes forward and keeps this one out.
JERMAINE BLACKWOOD walks in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh dear, what a mess! This is disastrous! Shorter outside off, Brathwaite pushes it towards Misbah at cover-point. They look for a single but there is hesitation. The nightwatchman sends back Brathwaite but the throw is quick and flat to the keeper who takes the bails off in a flash. This is just far too poor from West Indies!
Floated on middle, played back to the bowler.
DEVENDRA BISHOO, the nightwatchman is the new man in.

OUT! Edged and gone! Rahat Ali strikes just at the stroke of stumps! Bowls a length delivery outside off, Samuels could have easily left it alone but ends up poking at it. Gets a thick nick which flies towards first slip where Sami Aslam takes a good low catch. Marlon walks back with a forlorn face. This is 50th Test wicket for Rahat Ali!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Marlon cuts it towards point where Yasir Shah makes a diving stop to his right.
Well-directed bouncer on off, Samuels watches at it till the last moment and then arches back to evade it.
Fuller and angled on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket.
On a good length and outside off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller in length and outside off, Samuels lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper.
On middle and leg, flicked towards the leg side.
Loopy ball around off, KB lets it go.
Around middle, bunted back to the bowler.
Lands it outside leg, gets it to turn away. Brathwaite looks to defend but gets an outside edge which falls short of Younis at first slip.
Kraigg has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball around off, defended off the back foot.
Comes forward and defends it towards the man at covers.
On a length and outside off, defended off the back foot.
Edged but doesn't carry! On a length and outside off, Samuels looks to guide it down to third man but gets an outside edge which falls just short of the man at first slip.
On a length and outside off, cut towards point.
Short and outside off, Samuels looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which goes towards second slip.
Fuller in length and just outside off, Samuels defends it off the back foot towards covers.
Floats it outside leg, Brathwaite keeps it out towards mid-wicket.
Goes round the wicket.
Dropped short outside off, Samuels cuts it through point for a run.
Fuller outside off, driven to covers by Samuels.
Short again on middle, spins away, Samuels is late but adjusts in time to keep it out.
Too full on middle, played back to the bowler.

FOUR! GONE THROUGH! Goes over the wicket, bowls it short outside off, Samuels goes back to cut that one. The ball flies off the outside edge through Younis Khan at first slip for a boundary to the third man fence.
Fuller in length and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Fuller in length and on the pads, Brathwaite gets across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on the stumps, stays low as well. KB covers the line and defends it back to Ali.
Fullish on middle, defended on the leg side.
FOUR! Too easy for Brathwaite! Fuller and straying on the pads, Kraigg just helps it on its way down to fine leg with a tickle for a boundary.
Fuller and curled in a bit, flicked towards the leg side.
FOUR! Flighted ball around middle, Samuels comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
Marlon comes down the track and works it towards the leg side.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards the leg side.
Samuels comes down the track and drives it straight to mid off.
Good length delivery on middle, defended on the leg side.
Good length delivery on middle, KB defends it off the back foot.
Flicked through the leg side for a couple.

NOT OUT! The decision stays as it is! Real waste of a review that as it was pitched outside leg. On a length and around leg, Kraigg looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire says not out. It is taken upstairs and the first replay was enough to make the decision, it pitched outside leg.
An LBW appeal against Brathwaite is taken upstairs.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven straight to the man at short cover.
Fuller in length and outside off, KB defends it down.
Rahat Ali comes back into the attack.
Another one which has flight on it, MS comes down the track and hits it back to the bowler who fakes throw it back at the striker's end.
Tossed up ball around off, Samuels comes down the track and could only dig it out.
Full on the stumps, buried into the ground.
Around middle and off, Samuels defends it back to the bowler.
Around middle and leg, Brathwaite looks to flick but gets a leading edge past silly point for a single.
Changes the angle and comes from around the wicket! Loopy ball around leg, Brathwaite comes forward to defend but the ball turns away and goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
Once again comes down the track but hits it straight to the man at covers.

FOUR! Lovely shot! Marlon Samuels is counter-attacking well out there! Babar gives this tons of flight and Samuels makes his mind up. Skips down the track, gets to the pitch of the delivery and creams it through covers for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Fuller and fired on the stumps, Brathwaite works it through backward square leg. Three runs taken.
Flighted ball around off, KB presses forward and defends.
Outside off, the batsman digs it into the ground.
This was another one asking to be hit! Shortish on middle, Samuels looks to put it away off the back foot but drags it off the toe end of the bat towards mid on.

FOUR! This should ease some nerves! Third boundary of the over already! Another short ball and served outside off, Marlon camps back and hits it through covers. Pierces the gap and there is no one in the deep. Runs flowing at the moment for the Windies.
FOUR! Bunted down the ground! Floated ball around off, Samuels clears his front leg and drives it past the bowler who dives to his left but fails to stop that one. It races down to the fence.
Tossed up ball around off, defended off the front foot gently.
FOUR! Cracked away! Short and turns away after pitching. Samuels gets back and cuts it through covers for a boundary all the way. A gentle loosener from the leggie.
Prods forward and pushes it past silly point.
A quick single! Full and around middle, Marlon drives it down to mid on and takes Rahat Ali on. The fielder fires a throw at the bowler's end but misses the shy. A risky single taken.
Tossed up ball around middle, pushed towards covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gives this one a bit more flight and bowls it around off, Samuels drives it back to Babar.
A loud shout for lbw! Loopy ball around middle, coming in with the angle. Samuels looks to defend it off the front foot but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but it was going down leg.
Floated ball around off, KB comes down the track and hits it on the bounce back to Yasir who returns the throw to the keeper.
Flattish outside off, KB camps back and plays it towards point.
Lunges forward and bunts it back to Yasir.
Tossed up ball around off, Brathwaite drives it towards mid off.
Shortish around off, cut towards point.
Flatter around middle and off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Comes forward on this loopy ball and keeps it out in time.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Marlon defends it watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Samuels comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Darts it around leg, Samuels makes room and then closes the face of the bat. Gets a safe leading edge towards covers.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Pushed through point for a single this time.

RUN OUT CHANCE! Tossed up ball around off, Marlon pushes it towards covers where it is stopped by the fielder by diving to his left. He then gets up and fires a throw at the striker's end but Marlon makes it in.

That was very close again! Skidding in with the angle around middle and off, Samuels makes a long stride forward to defend but keeps his bat very close to the pads. Gets an inside edge there. Yasir Shah is eyeing that only, he wants to hit the pads.
Tossed up ball around middle, Samuels lunges forward and blocks it down.
Pushed towards the man at covers.
Loopy ball around middle, turning sharply. Samuels defends it gently.
Fuller in length and around off, defended back to the bowler.
On a length and around middle, it stays very low after pitching. Brathwaite hops in the crease and defends it down.
Good length ball on the pads, flicked through the leg side for a single.
In the channel outside off, MS lets it go.
Angles it on middle, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length and outside off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Tossed up outside off, Samuels defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up around off, Samuels leaves it alone.

NOT OUT! The decision is overturned yet again! Marlon Samuels survives a real scare here! Tossed up ball around middle, Samuels prods forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Samuels opts for the review and replays show there was bat involved.
Marlon Samuels is adjudged LBW but the umpire. He opts for the review straightaway. Is it bat first or pad?
MARLON SAMUELS is the new man in.

OUT! The decision is overturned and Darren Bravo has to make his way back to the pavilion. He bangs the bat on the turf as he walks back! Yasir Shah strikes and the ploy to bowl him on the pads has paid off. Bowls a loopy leg spinner around middle, it skids a touch after pitching. Bravo looks to pull this across the line but completely misses the line and is hit flush on the pads. The leggie turns back and appeals, actually pleads for an LBW but the umpire says not out. The bowler then asks Misbah to take the review and replays show it pitched in line and would have gone on to hit the stumps. Big blow for the Windies, this.
Pakistan have taken a review against Darren Bravo. Yasir Shah is confident and asks his skipper to take the review.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, Kraigg gets across and flicks it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his left and parries it towards mid on.
Fuller in length and outside off, KB looks to drive this through covers but the ball shapes away at the last minute and he gets beaten.
Good length delivery outside off, cut towards point.
Very full and outside off, Brathwaite drives it towards covers.
Hits the deck and serves it outside off, Kraigg makes a leave to the keeper.
Fuller in length delivery on off, Brathwaite drives it towards mid off.
DRINKS BREAK!
Another look at the ball from the umpires.
Quicker on off, Bravo pulls it towards mid on off the crease.
Bravo comes forward and nudges it towards short leg.
Floated on off, Bravo comes forward, pushes it to covers and looks for a single but is sent back.
Fuller outside off, driven in the air by Brathwaite but wide of the fielder at mid off.
Floated on middle, Brathwaite comes forward and blocks it.
Shorter on off, turns away, Brathwaite stays back and punches it to covers.
They are having a look at the ball. The 8-shape gauge is out but the umpire finds it good enough.
Fuller outside off, Bravo drives it towards covers off his crease.
Fuller in length on off, worked through mid wicket for a single.
Fuller on the pads, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite taps it towards cover-point and takes a quick single.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite pushes it to covers coming forward.
On a length outside off, Brathwaite plays it towards covers. Not sure if he actually wanted to play that one that way.
Bravo comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Shorter on off, Bravo punches it towards mid on.
Thankfully this one is on the stumps, kept out towards short leg by Bravo.
And another one is drifted down the leg side, Bravo again fails to clip it. The keeper collects and appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Another one down the leg side, Bravo again fails to connect with his sweep.
Floated on the pads, Bravo looks to clip it but is beaten.
Good length outside off, left alone by Brathwaite.
On a length outside off, another leave by Brathwaite.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite drives it towards mid off.
Good length outside off, left alone by Brathwaite.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite digs it out.
Fuller outside off, pushed deep into covers for a single.
Sohail Khan called back on.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite keeps it out.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Tossed up on middle, Bravo top edges his sweep through square leg for a triple. That came off the back end of the bat.
Shorter outside off, cut towards point for a single.
Shorter outside off, cut towards point.
Fuller outside off, pushed to covers by Brathwaite.
YASIR SHAH introduced into the attack.
Flatter on the pads, nudged down to square leg.
Fuller outside off, Bravo comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Shorter on off, worked towards mid-wicket off the crease.
Floated outside off, Bravo comes forward and pads it away.
Fuller on off, played back down the wicket by Bravo.
Floated on middle, Brathwaite clips it towards mid-wicket off the crease for a single.
Fuller outside off, Bravo punches it towards mid off from his crease.
Good length outside off, punched towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Bravo comes forward and defends it to covers.
Fuller in length on middle, Bravo tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Bravo plays it back down the wicket.
FOUR! BANG! Starts off with a gentle loosener outside off, asking to be hit. Bravo gets on top of it and pummels it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was hit with a lot of disdain.
Sohail Khan comes back on.
Drives this one towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite pushes it to the left of mid off.
On a length on off, Brathwaite defends it back down the wicket.
Slanted across off, left alone by Brathwaite.
Good length outside off, Brathwaite defends it back down the wicket.
On a length outside off, pushed towards covers by Brathwaite.
Floated on off, Bravo defends it.
EDGED! Fuller on off, Bravo looks to defend but gets a leading edge past point for a couple of runs as Younis gives chase from first slip.
Turns in from outside off, Bravo keep it down towards the on side.
Shorter outside off, Bravo defends it.
Quick single! Brathwaite pushes it towards mid on and calls his partner through for a quick single. The throw comes in at the striker's end but Bravo was in.

Floated around off, Bravo defends it with soft hands towards first slip. The ball does not carry to Younis who dives to his left. He though gets a hand to it and a single is taken as the ball goes behind him.
Landed outside off, Brathwaite pushes it back down the wicket.
On a length outside off, Brathwaite defends it from his crease.
Fuller on the stumps, Brathwaite clips it towards mid-wicket.
Worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! EDGED! On a length outside off, Bravo looks to defend from his crease but gets it down to third man off the edge for a boundary.
Good length outside off, played towards point by Bravo.
Fuller on off, Bravo clips it through mid on for a single.
Brathwaite comes forward and defends it towards backward square off the inside edge for a single.
This one is pushed towards covers by Brathwaite.
Bravo works it through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, played back to the bowler by Bravo.
Shorter on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on off, Bravo pushes it towards covers off his crease.
Bravo pushes this one towards covers off his crease.
FOUR! SWEET! Fuller outside off, Bravo just stands his crease and caresses this one through covers for a majestic boundary. That was a lovely shot. Pleasing to the eyes.
Good length on middle, tucke through backward square leg for a single.

Good length outside off, Bravo stands tall and punches it on the up through extra cover. The fielder chasing it does well to haul it back in but ends up throwing it wide of Yasir who is backing him up. Misbah was the culprit. Three runs taken.
Good length outside off, no shot offered by Bravo.
Floated outside off, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it to covers.
Drifts it on the pads, Brathwaite pushes it towards mid on.
Floated outside off, pushed it towards point off his crease for a single.
Slanted on the pads, worked to square leg for a quick single.
Works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Bravo keeps this out.
Fuller outside off, comes in late, Brathwaite works it towards square leg off the inner half of the bat.
Definite reverse! Another one bowled full and outside off, kept out by Brathwaite.

JUST SHORT! Fuller outside off, swings away late, Brathwaite pushes at it and gets an outside edge that flies through towards the keeper. Sarfraz dives to his right but the ball drops just in front of him.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite comes forward and pushes it to covers.
On a length but on the pads, Brathwaite fails to clip it through. Another loud appeal but the umpire is not interested. That looked not out to the naked eye too as it pitched way outside leg.
Kraigg Brathwaite walks in to bat at Number 3.

OUT! RAHAT STRIKES! Fuller in length on off and middle, Johnson looks to clip it but is beaten and is hit on his pads. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The batsmen have a chat but decide against the review. Johnson has to go and Pakistan have struck early after Tea!
Lands it outside off, Bravo plays it back down the wicket.
Spins in from outside off, Bravo gets across and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, kept out by Bravo.
Floated outside off, Bravo comes forward and blocks it.
Shorter on off, punched towards mid on by Bravo.
Floated outside off, Bravo comes forward and pushes it to silly point.
Zulfiqar Babar to bowl from the other end.
On a length on off, played towards mid on by Johnson off the inner half of the bat.
Fuller in length on off, kept out towards the on side by Johnson.
On a length outside off, pushed into covers.
Good length outside off, Johnson does not bother.
Wide outside off, left alone by Johnson.
On a length outside off, Johnson punches it towards covers off his crease. Azhar at covers makes a diving stop.

Welcome back for the final session of play. We have a lot of overs to be bowled and can expect this to be a longer session. West Indies will want to not lose too many wickets while Pakistan will want to take at least two to three wickets to stay on top. DARREN BRAVO and LEON JOHNSON are out to bat for West Indies. Pakistan begin with RAHAT ALI. Here we go...
...DAY 2...SESSION 3....

Misbah has already introduced the spinners into the attack but the leggie Yasir Shah is yet to come. Once he gets the cherry, it will be interesting to see how the visitors tackle him. The overrate isn't impressive at all and let's hope for the best now. Join us back shortly for the last session.

A good passage of play for the West Indies! Firstly they bowled out the home side for 452, courtesy an impressive pace bowling from Gabriel who registered his maiden 5-wicket haul. Then when they came out to bat, the openers Bravo and Johnson saw off the 11 overs and scored 27.
Tossed up ball around off, Bravo prods forward and blocks it out gently. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 2!
Slower through the air and outside off, Darren gets back and pushes it towards point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Booming drive, that! Babar tosses it up outside off, Bravo clears his front leg and creams it past mid off. The fielder gives it a chase but it never looked like he will cut it off.
Pushed quicker through the air and it's kept out nicely.
Tossed up delivery around middle and off, played gently.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Flighted delivery around off, Bravo makes room and drives it along the ground through covers for a single.
Drifting on the pads, Darren comes forward and keeps it out watchfully.
Short and around off, punched through covers for a single.
Full on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler who dives to his left to stop that one.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, punched on the leg side.

Carlos Brathwaite is seen enjoying near the side lines. He is having popcorn and I am sure he loves it a lot. He filled so much in his hand and gobbled it. Meanwhile, ASAD SHAFIQ comes into the attack!
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and around off, defended gently.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up ball around off, blocked into the ground.
Flatter through the air outside off, Johnson punches it towards mid off.
Flighted ball around off, Johnson comes forward and defends it down.
Banged short on middle, Bravo ducks underneath it.
Comes from over the wicket and bowls it down the leg side, pulled through square leg for a single.
On a length and around off, Johnson plays it with soft hands towards the off side.
Gets behind the line and shows a straight bat.
Good length delivery on off, Bravo looks to defend but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery on off, pushed towards covers.

In the air... clears mid on! Floated ball around middle and off, Johnson looks to go over the top and ends up miscuing it in the air. Luckily for him it clears the man at mid on. Babar almost got a wicket in the first over. Two runs taken.
Outside off, Johnson gets back and pushes it towards point.
Tossed up around middle and off, buried into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Plunges forward and keeps it out on the off side.
Loopy ball around off, Johnson prods forward and pushes it towards covers.
ZULFIQAR BABAR into the attack now!

FOUR! How about that shot! Wow! So good to see southpaws essaying such shots through the off side. Rahat Ali gives enough width and Bravo will make you pay for it. Gets back and punches it on the up through covers for a rocketing boundary. All timing!
Back of a length ball on off, Bravo shows the full face of the bat and taps it on the off side.
Angles it on the pads, tucked towards the leg side.
On a length and outside off, Bravo defends it down.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

A shout for a catch, not given! On a length and outside off, Bravo drops his wrists down at the last moment but the ball goes off his left arm and flies into the keeper's gloves. They go up in an appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. Misbah doesn't want to take the review as he signals it's hit the arm.
Similar kind of shot played by Johnson just like Bravo got off the mark. The only difference is this time the fielder gives it a chase and keeps them down to a couple.
On a length and around off, pushed off the back foot towards covers for a single.

FOUR! Bravo has taken 15 balls to get off the mark but is underway in style! Rahat bowls a back of a length delivery on off, Bravo gets back and crunches it through covers. Through the gap and it races away to the fence. Good shot, DB!
Back of a length delivery on off, tapped towards the off side.
Short of a length delivery, angling in, Bravo says I have nothing to offer, mate.
Back of a length delivery on off, Johnson gets back and pulls it awkwardly through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and just outside off, Bravo covers the line neatly and answers it with a straight bat.
Angles in on middle, Bravo defends it to the leg side.
In the corridor of uncertainty, DB makes an easy leave to the keeper.
Good length delivery on off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Another edge but it's to no avail! Good length delivery, curling back in sharply. Bravo looks to defend it down the ground but gets an outside edge and much to his delight it falls short of second slip.
Edged but falls short! Fullish on off, Bravo looks to cover the line and defend but the ball kisses the outside part of the willow and falls just short of the man at second slip.
Make it three in a row! Good length outside off, the batsman lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Comes in with the angle, Johnson makes a watchful leave to the keeper.
Fuller outside off, doesn't rise at all. Johnson has got nothing to do with that one.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards the off side.
In the corridor outside off, Johnson shoulders his arms to that one.

FOUR! Handsomely pulled! Rahat Ali bowls a back of a length delivery on middle, comes up at a nice height too. Johnson is up for it as he gets back, swivels a bit and pulls it in front of square for a boundary. Lovely way to get off the mark.
Fuller in length and around off, Darren gets on the front foot and pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller in length and shapes away a touch after pitching, Bravo tries to play it inside the line and is beaten all ends up.
Fuller in length on off, Bravo plays it back down the wicket.
Slanted outside off, Bravo looks to play at first but then wants to not play. The ball goes off the bottom edge towards the keeper who dives to his left and stops it.
Hurls it on a length on off, Bravo comes forward and defends it.
Fuller way outside off, Bravo throws his bat at it and but seems to have missed it. The bowler thinks that is out and appeals along with the keeper but the umpire stays unmoved.
Sohail Khan to bowl from the other end.
Angles it on a length on middle and leg, Johnson looks to clip and is hit on his pads. Bowlers appeal at first but then aborts it spotting it was going down leg.
Slanted down the leg side, Johnson looks to clip it but fails to connect.
On a length on off, Johnson comes forward and defends it.
This one is left alone by Johnson.
On a length outside off, keeps a touch low, Johnson looks to cut it through but is beaten.
Kraigg Brathwaite could not open the batting since he was out of the field for a long time. He has been handed a 3-minute penalty and only then he can be eligible to bat.
Begins with one that is bowled on the pads, Johnson lets it hit his pads as it was far too down the leg side.
